# healthgoth

Health Goth is a radical gothic typeface inspired by the old-school blackletter tradition.
The font was created for the Hungry book. Now it's available for everybody.

More info: 
Web: http://healthgoth.popkern.co/get/

Unbounded Variable Font
=======================

This download contains Unbounded as both a variable font and static fonts.

Unbounded is a variable font with this axis:
  wght

This means all the styles are contained in a single file:
  Unbounded/Unbounded-VariableFont_wght.ttf

If your app fully supports variable fonts, you can now pick intermediate styles
that aren’t available as static fonts. Not all apps support variable fonts, and
in those cases you can use the static font files for Unbounded:
  Unbounded/static/Unbounded-ExtraLight.ttf
  Unbounded/static/Unbounded-Light.ttf
  Unbounded/static/Unbounded-Regular.ttf
  Unbounded/static/Unbounded-Medium.ttf
  Unbounded/static/Unbounded-SemiBold.ttf
  Unbounded/static/Unbounded-Bold.ttf
  Unbounded/static/Unbounded-ExtraBold.ttf
  Unbounded/static/Unbounded-Black.ttf

Get started
-----------

1. Install the font files you want to use

2. Use your app's font picker to view the font family and all the
available styles

-------------------------------

  https://developers.google.com/web/fundamentals/design-and-ux/typography/variable-fonts
